commit.message:
fix: replace ${CLAUDE_SKILL_ROOT} with skill-root-relative paths (#146)

## Problem

`${CLAUDE_SKILL_ROOT}` is used across multiple skills to reference
bundled scripts and files. This causes two problems in Claude Code:

1. **Permission friction** — variable expansion in bash commands
triggers a confirmation prompt
2. **Runtime failure** — after confirmation, the variable is not set, so
paths resolve to `/scripts/foo.py` → file not found

Reported by Phil in
[#proj-junior](https://sentry.slack.com/archives/C07P2KGJGG0/p1778225171252819).

## Changes

Replaced all `${CLAUDE_SKILL_ROOT}/...` references with
skill-root-relative paths (e.g. `scripts/foo.py`, `references/bar.md`)
per the [Agent Skills spec](https://agentskills.io/specification).

**Affected skills (8 files):**
- `iterate-pr/SKILL.md` — 14 refs → all converted; updated guidance text
- `gh-review-requests/SKILL.md` — 2 refs
- `presentation-creator/SKILL.md` — 4 refs
- `presentation-creator/references/design-system.md` — 3 refs
- `skill-scanner/SKILL.md` — 6 refs; updated guidance text
- `sred-project-organizer/SKILL.md` — 4 refs
- `skill-writer/SOURCES.md` — changelog entry added
- `skill-writer/references/registration-validation.md` — updated
meta-guidance to recommend against env var path prefixes

## Verification

```bash
# Only remaining mentions are in skill-writer changelog/meta docs (documenting the change itself)
grep -rn "CLAUDE_SKILL_ROOT" skills/ --include="*.md"
```

Closes #145

Co-authored-by: junior[bot] <junior[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>
